verdicts.title: p-adic Equiangular Lines and p-adic van Lint-Seidel Relative Bound
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the notion of p-adic equiangular lines and derive the first fundamental relation between common angle, dimension of the space and the number of lines. More precisely, we show that if $\{τ_j\}_{j=1}^n$ is p-adic $γ$-equiangular lines in $\mathbb{Q}^d_p$, then \begin{align*} (1) \quad\quad \quad \quad |n|^2\leq |d|\max\{|n|, γ^2 \}. \end{align*} We call Inequality (1) as the p-adic van Lint-Seidel relative bound. verdicts.title: Note on $p$-adic Local Functional Equation
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given primes $\ell\ne p$, we record here a $p$-adic valued Fourier theory on a local field over $\mathbf{Q}_\ell$, which is developed under the perspective of group schemes. As an application, by substituting rigid analysis for complex analysis, it leads naturally to the $p$-adic local functional equation at $\ell$, which strongly resembles the complex one in Tate's thesis.
